title: Algorithms & Data Structures Curriculum Coordinator
description: Alexandria Technical University (ATU) is seeking an Algorithms & Data Structures Curriculum Coordinator to lead our summer undergraduate computer science tracks. In this seasonal academic role, you will be responsible for lecturing on basic programming, data structures, algorithms, and discrete mathematics. You will coordinate with faculty, lead a group of teaching assistants, and provide career and academic counseling to students. The ideal candidate has significant teaching assistantship or assistant professorship experience and a background in leading academic initiatives or university career centers.
requirements: 5+ years of experience as a university Teaching Assistant, Assistant Professor, or academic coordinator in computer science.
Proven experience leading academic programs, university centers (e.g., career centers), or coordinating course curriculums.
Deep pedagogical knowledge in instructing data structures, algorithms, discrete mathematics, and basic programming concepts.
Bilingual fluency in Arabic and English, with a strong commitment to delivering engaging learning experiences.
Master's degree in Computer Software Engineering or a related technical discipline.
benefits: Access to university research databases and resources
